newsitem.title: KYRGYZSTAN: Kyrgyz air carrier to fly to China's Urumqi.
newsitem.headline: Kyrgyz air carrier to fly to China's Urumqi.

text.p: Kyrgyzstan's national air carrier Kyrgyzstan Aba Zholdoru has started regular flights to Urumqi, the capital of China's northern Xinjiang province, the company's spokeswoman said on Friday.
Elmira Toktogulova told Reuters that the new route -- some 1,350 km (844 miles) long -- is served by Tupolev 134 planes. Flights are once a week on Tuesdays.
"Until now flights to Urumqi were only charter ones, used mostly by traders. Other passengers could reach the city only via (the Kazakh capital) Almaty," Toktogulova said.
Another reason for the new line was to enable residents of Kyrgyzstan to visit their Turkic-speaking relatives in Xinjiang, she added.

Kyrgyzstan Aba Zholdoru is currently flying to 24 cities in India, China, United Arab Emirates, Turkey, Italy, Germany, Malaysia, Thailand and Great Britain, as well as to 17 destinations in the former Soviet Union.
